title: 🛫 New Training & missions in MSFS Marketplace|Weekly Update|Master Your Flight Skills! |Week 4✈️
description:
🔍 Description
🚀 Discover the latest training added to the Microsoft Flight Simulator (MSFS) marketplace this week! This week, several mission packs are available to enhance your commercial pilot skills, as well as some missions that will take you back to the future in honor of AlItalia airlines. Watch now to see how you can elevate your flight simulation experience! 🌟

📹 Other marketplace additions
If you are looking for either the new enhanced scenery and enhanced airports or new aircrafts and liveries review the respective video by clicking on one if the links below:
